codes.title: Unlimited allowance requested
codes.meaning: The evaluated action grants an effectively unbounded token allowance to a spender.

codes.title: Allowance to unverified spender
codes.meaning: An allowance is granted to a contract with no verification/reputation evidence available.

codes.title: Blanket operator approval
codes.meaning: The action grants collection-wide operator authority (setApprovalForAll-class), equivalent to unlimited transfer rights over the assets.

codes.title: Drainer-pattern interaction
codes.meaning: The action matches a known wallet-drainer mechanic (e.g. broad approval followed by sweep authority).

codes.title: Lookalike domain
codes.meaning: The origin domain is a homoglyph/typosquat candidate of a known target.

codes.title: Recently registered domain
codes.meaning: The origin domain's observed age is below the caution threshold.

codes.title: Encoded (punycode) label
codes.meaning: The host contains an xn-- encoded label, a common carrier for homoglyph attacks; review the decoded form.

codes.title: Brand embedded in deceptive host
codes.meaning: A known brand appears as a subdomain or token of a host whose registrable domain is unrelated to that brand.

codes.title: Impersonation indicator
codes.meaning: Content or identity signals impersonate a known brand, person, or contract.

codes.title: Command-injection ask
codes.meaning: Content asks the target to execute commands, paste code, or bypass safeguards.

codes.title: Seed phrase / private key request
codes.meaning: Content asks the target to reveal, enter, verify, or import a seed phrase, recovery phrase, or private key.

codes.title: Crypto prepayment ask
codes.meaning: Content asks for cryptocurrency payment as a precondition (job, prize, release of funds, verification).

codes.title: Gift card payment ask
codes.meaning: Content asks the target to buy or share gift cards / gift card codes as payment.

codes.title: Remote access / software install ask
codes.meaning: Content asks the target to install remote-access or screen-sharing software, or to grant device control.

codes.title: Unverified contract
codes.meaning: No verified source or reputation evidence exists for the contract.

codes.title: Insufficient evidence
codes.meaning: The detector could not gather enough evidence to assess the subject; result is unknown, not low.

codes.title: Mock finding
codes.meaning: Produced by a labeled mock detector for testing/demonstration; carries no real detection meaning.
